items.title: 2.5.3.1 Module Search Path and Package Structure (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the module search path and packages (PDF 49-50).

blocks.text: Jab aap koi module import karte hain to Python usay ek khaas order (tarteeb) mein dhoondti hai. Aayiye har step aasan misaal se dekhein.
1. Current directory (abhi wala folder): Python sab se pehle us folder mein dekhti hai jahan aap ka script rakha hai. Farz karein aap ke folder mein main.py script aur helper.py module dono hain.
Misaal: helper.py mein:

def greet () :
    return " As – Salaam Alaikum from helper.py!"
main.py mein:

import helper
message = helper.greet()
print(message) # Output : As - Salaam-Alaikum from helper.py!

Wazahat: helper.py usi folder mein hai jahan main.py hai, is liye Python usay dhoond kar import kar leti hai. Asal output helper.py ki string hai: " As – Salaam Alaikum from helper.py!" (comment mein likhe words se thora alag).

2. Standard library: current folder mein module na mile to Python standard library mein dekhti hai, jis mein bohat se built-in modules hain. Maslan random numbers ke liye standard library ka random module. (Kitab is step ko bhi "1." number deti hai.)
Misaal: main.py mein:

import random
number = random.randint(1, 10)
print(f"Random number: {number}")  # ‘f’ is used to place the value of a variable in a string
# Output:
# Random number:  7 (or any number between 1 and 10)
Wazahat: random Python ki standard library ka hissa hai, is liye baghair kisi mushkil ke mil jata hai. f"..." string mein { } ke andar variable ki value aa jati hai.
Package structure

Bare projects mein modules ko packages mein rakha jata hai. Package bas ek folder hai jis mein milte julte modules hon. Maslan e-commerce (online dukaan) platform ke liye ecommerce naam ka package, jis mein products.py, customers.py aur orders.py modules hon.
Misaal: ecommerce/products.py mein:

def list_products () :
    return ["Laptop","Mobile", "Tablet"]

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab function ka naam 1ist_products chhapti hai, yani shuru mein digit 1. Naam digit se shuru nahi ho sakta (SyntaxError), aur main script list_products() bulata hai. Sahi: def list_products():
Main script mein:

from ecommerce import products
available_products = products.list_products()
print(available_products)
#    Output :
#    ['Laptop', 'Mobile', 'Tablet']

Wazahat: yahan ecommerce package hai aur products.py module. from ecommerce import products se module aata hai aur output ['Laptop', 'Mobile', 'Tablet'] hai. Is structure (banawat) se code organized aur sambhalne mein aasan rehta hai.

blocks.title: Tidbits
blocks.text: Modules ko packages mein rakhna aisa hai jaise library mein kitabein alag alag hisson mein rakhna: code dhoondna aur sambhalna aasan ho jata hai.

blocks.prompt: import helper likhne par Python sab se pehle kahan dhoondti hai?
blocks.explanation: Chalne wale script ke current folder mein; wahan na mile to standard library mein.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Python pehle current folder, phir standard library mein module dhoondti hai.
Package: modules ka folder; from package import module.
